label: MONEY TIP
hook: Try one no-spend day a week

slides.text: Pick one day a week when you spend only on essentials.
slides.sub: Bills, groceries and your daily commute are fine

slides.text: Carry lunch from home, skip online shopping, make your chai at home.
If that saves ₹300 each week, that's ₹15,600 in a year.
Bonus: you start noticing which spends you don't miss at all.
Try this today: choose your no-spend day for this week.
